def maxCandies(status, candies, keys, containedBoxes, initialBoxes):
    open_boxes = set(initialBoxes)
    available_keys = set()
    available_boxes = set(initialBoxes)
    total_candies = 0

    while open_boxes:
        current_box = open_boxes.pop()
        total_candies += candies[current_box]
        available_keys.update(keys[current_box])
        available_boxes.update(containedBoxes[current_box])

        # Add new boxes that can be opened with available keys
        open_boxes.update(box for box in available_boxes if status[box] == 1 and box in available_keys)

        # Remove boxes that have been opened from available boxes
        available_boxes.difference_update(open_boxes)

    return total_candies
